title: Answer Cue on Write-on-Line

illustrates.quote: Follow print for answer cues that appear on the write-on-line.

print.printFeatures: The words "to go" are printed directly on the fill-in write-on-line itself.

braille.notes: Independently re-extracted from source (fixed left margin / line-number field stripped by counting; U+2800→space; trailing spaces removed); confirmed byte-identical to both run A and run B (gold-10-A/gold-10-B) except where differences.md records a correction.

resolution: Braille matches both A and B exactly. Print unchanged from A/B.

corrections.note: Errata (C6): the book's expected braille was missing the word-run terminator _' before the closing quotation mark. Emboss's stripWordRunTerminator (document.mjs) deliberately removes this terminator to match the uncorrected book; removing that strip is tracked separately as K22 (code change, out of scope for this gold-only correction). liblouis on its own already gives the corrected form.
